summary: The comment highlights the critical role of E-Rate funding in supporting libraries and schools, which provide essential services to communities. The comment opposes any sunset or significant limitation of E-Rate funding, arguing that it would lead to cuts in services and programs, disproportionately affecting lower-income communities. The comment supports maintaining E-Rate funding to ensure libraries and schools can continue to serve as gateways to education, employment, information, technology, and opportunity for all.

claims.requested_action: Terminate or significantly limit E-Rate funding
claims.argument: Without E-Rate, libraries and schools would face difficult choices, including cutting core services, programs, and operations simply to maintain the Internet access on which their communities depend
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, libraries and schools would face difficult choices, including cutting core services, programs, and operations simply to maintain the Internet access on which their communities depend.

claims.argument: Protecting E-Rate will help ensure libraries and schools can continue to serve as gateways to education, employment, information, technology, and opportunity for all
claims.evidence_quote: Protecting E-Rate will help ensure that libraries and schools can continue to serve as gateways to education, employment, information, technology, and opportunity for all.
